sourceChanges.reason: Original score-path derivation subtracts sizeof("mosu") from a valid basename argv[0], writing one byte before its stack buffer. Use the last path separator when present and the complete basename buffer otherwise. Actual original main checked-copy-boundary RED/GREEN covers basename, relative path and absolute path launches.

Original vg_paintPixel accepted x==framebuffer width or y==framebuffer height. Right-edge pixels could wrap into the next row, and bottom-edge pixels wrote beyond the allocated software framebuffer. Clip at or beyond each dimension before computing the address. Coordinates are unsigned, so negative comparisons were ineffective.
sourceChanges.verification: Actual original renderer initialized through vg_init fails guarded allocation regression. Repaired renderer preserves first/last valid corner colors, clips exact width/height, beyond-edge and unsigned-maximum coordinates, and presents the unchanged valid pixels through vg_nextFrame. RED/GREEN: build/arcade-100/a/mosu-edge-fix/{red,green}.log.

controlsRationale: Relative swipe aims. Select chooses Play, then the next menu shifts the cursor100 pixels left. Easy creates a new cursor500,500; aim at visible circles and tap Q/W/E/R as the outer ring shrinks. Dedicated Q/W left and E/R right controls also support original hard-mode letter prompts. No generic pads or unused keyboard. Actual easy touch hits rendered green checkmarks in4 trials, Escape returned to the original menu. Hard mode is not yet gameplay-verified.
